[P2] Preserve SDK outcomes when completion reporting fails

If the S3 publication here or the following `publish_observation` fails after `invoke()` returns, the surrounding exception handler records `WRAPPER_RAISE` and re-raises the storage error. This discards the SDK response, can trigger an artificial invocation retry, and records a failure the SDK never raised. Separate completion publication from SDK exception classification and contain publication failures as observation errors while preserving the original result or exception. Add a handler-level failing-sink regression; the new `ObservedClient` tests do not cover this boundary.
